subject: computer-science
title: Robotics, Automation and Real-Time Systems
welcome_lead: From factory robots to drones: software meets the physical world on a deadline.
meta_desc: CS adventure on robotics, automation and real-time embedded systems.
final_note: Real-time: correctness depends on meeting deadlines!

concepts.def: Use of control systems to operate equipment.
Must respond within strict time bounds.
Late results degrade quality not safety.

walkthroughs.body_html:
6-axis arm has 6 degrees of freedom.

Each joint controlled by servo with feedback encoder.

Real-time OS uses priority-based scheduling.

Time-critical tasks preempt lower-priority work.

Automation displaces jobs but increases safety in hazardous tasks.

Designers must consider failure modes and safety interlocks.
